in_sanskrit.name: Sarif
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है King of the River
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sarif एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sarif is derived from the Sanskrit and Hindi words sar and if, which mean 'king' and 'river' respectively. This name is suitable for a child born near a river or for a child who is expected to rule over a body of water. It is also a name for a king or a ruler.

in_marathi.name: Sarif
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of the River
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarif हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sarif is derived from the Sanskrit and Hindi words sar and if, which mean 'king' and 'river' respectively. This name is suitable for a child born near a river or for a child who is expected to rule over a body of water. It is also a name for a king or a ruler.
